build_system_fingerprint_full: build a system fingerprint string with version, parallelism, and config hash using the full mode
build_system_fingerprint_hash: build a system fingerprint string with version and config hash using the hash mode without parallelism details
build_system_fingerprint_custom: build a system fingerprint string using a custom user-provided value via the custom mode
get_system_fingerprint: get the system fingerprint for a vLLM config using the currently configured fingerprint mode
set_default_fingerprint_mode: set the default fingerprint mode to full, hash, custom, or none for the OpenAI-compatible server
